entries.targetIncarnation: Nintendo3DS2012 catalogue identity; PC/HD2013 native publication shown separately.
entries.pivotScope: Fixed projection of source x/z zero at the all-frame source-space minimum Y; floor proxy, not independently verified anatomical foot contact.

recipe.boundsScope: Union of every native 60 Hz exported sample plus the complete native clip endpoint. Camera remains fixed per side throughout the clip.

limitations: Opaque published clip codes are retained without guessing an action.
Every exported frame is sampled from the native FBX skeleton at a distinct native key time; the duplicate clip endpoint is retained separately for loop seam review.
Side views use actual opposing cameras; no image or geometry is mirrored.
A fixed source-bounds floor proxy is not an original game collision/foot contact.
Three.js does not support the published FBX SpecularFactor texture channel; original game lighting/material appearance remains unverified.
Published PC/HD2013 source geometry and motion are not silently promoted to Nintendo3DS2012.
entries.variantScope: Voluntary aquatic source-observed presentation during the adapted 2D waiting state; no original idle, target3DS equivalence or terrestrial contact certified.

visualReview.notes: Le corps marin reste centré, incliné dans une attitude de nage stationnaire. Ses bras/appendices avant et jambes postérieures oscillent tandis que la grande membrane dorsale fléchit, sans frappe, transformation ou déplacement global observé. Les deux côtés montrent les mêmes éléments sources avec des caméras opposées réelles. Il s’agit d’une variante volontaire de présentation marine pendant l’attente de notre adaptation 2D, et non de la preuve d’un idle original ou d’un appui terrestre.

continuityMeasurements.bottomSliceDriftScope: Fixed vertices lying in the first-pose bottom5percent of sourceheight; an anatomical foot-contact approximation, not bone semantics or original collision.
